results.name: Scripts only load from trusted hosts
results.summary: All 1 scripts came from trusted hosts.
results.source: network log (HAR) Kane CLI recorded during the "swap-flow" run
results.fix: Remove scripts loaded from third-party CDNs, or bundle them with the app. Every script that runs on a dApp page can read and change what the user signs, so drainers are often injected this way.

results.fix: Make sure entering an amount shows a quote, Review swap opens the confirmation, and Confirm swap shows the success message. The transaction sent to the wallet must match the confirmation exactly: the same amount, sent only to your trusted swap contract, with no token approvals for addresses you don't trust.
